metadata.title: Pass 3 reference table: Goldbeter (2007) FGF8/RA bistable determination front, Dubrulle & Pourquie (2004) fgf8 mRNA decay gradient, Dubrulle et al. (2001) FGF8 bead perturbation, and Farhadifar (2007) vertex-model paraxial mesoderm sheet

sources.citation: Goldbeter A, Gonze D, Pourquie O (2007). Sharp developmental thresholds defined through bistability by antagonistic gradients of retinoic acid and FGF signaling. Developmental Dynamics 236(6):1495-1508.
Dubrulle J, Pourquie O (2004). fgf8 mRNA decay establishes a gradient that couples axial elongation to patterning in the vertebrate embryo. Nature 427(6973):419-422.
Dubrulle J, McGrew MJ, Pourquie O (2001). FGF signaling controls somite boundary position and regulates segmentation clock control of spatiotemporal Hox gene activation. Cell 106(2):219-232.
Farhadifar R, Roper J-C, Aigouy B, Eaton S, Julicher F (2007). The influence of cell mechanics, cell-cell interactions, and proliferation on epithelial packing. Current Biology 17(24):2095-2104.
Bi D, Lopez JH, Schwarz JM, Manning ML (2015). A density-independent rigidity transition in biological tissues. Nature Physics 11:1074-1079.
Saga Y, Takeda H (2001). The making of the somite: molecular events in vertebrate segmentation. Nature Reviews Genetics 2(11):835-845.

goldbeter_2007_fgf_ra_toggle_reduced.description: Two-variable reduction of the Goldbeter-Gonze-Pourquie (2007) FGF/RA mutual-inhibition model. RA represses fgf8 (Hill, K_RF, n); FGF represses RA (Raldh2 repression + Cyp26 induction lumped into one Hill term, K_FR, n). F and R are normalised protein levels; M_F is fgf8 mRNA normalised to its tailbud level. The intermediates Cyp26 / Raldh2 of the published model are NOT represented explicitly (residual carried to Pass 4).

equations.fgf8: tau_FR * dF/dt = alpha_F * M_F(x,t) * K_RF^n / (K_RF^n + R^n) - F
equations.retinoic_acid: tau_FR * dR/dt = alpha_R * K_FR^n / (K_FR^n + F^n) - R
equations.fgf8_mrna_gradient: M_F(x,t) = exp(-(x_tb(t) - x) / lambda_F),  x_tb(t) = x_tb0 + v_tb * t,  lambda_F = v_tb / k_dM   (Dubrulle & Pourquie 2004)
equations.cusp_coupling: a(x,t) = tanh((R - F) / kappa_a);  m(x,t) = F^4 / (F^4 + K_mob^4)
equations.determination_front: x_w(t) = x_tb(t) - lambda_F * ln(1 / M_lo)  =>  dx_w/dt = v_tb

derived_at_v_tb_2_2222_um_per_min.M_hi_saddle_node: none below M_F = 1.6 (tailbud M_F = 1 remains in the bistable window, FGF-high branch)

reference_claims.front_velocity_equals_elongation: Goldbeter et al. (2007) Fig. 2-4: the switching threshold of the bistable FGF/RA system defines a sharp determination front that moves posteriorly with axis elongation.
reference_claims.fgf8_bead_smaller_somites: Dubrulle et al. (2001) Cell 106:219-232: FGF8-soaked beads implanted in the PSM shift the determination front posteriorly and produce smaller somites at the level of the bead; no numerical size ratio is reported, so the comparison is directional (ratio < 1).

farhadifar_2007_vertex_sheet.description: Pointy-top hexagonal vertex model of the anterior 1.2 mm of the paraxial mesoderm sheet (60 x 6 cells, 20 um AP pitch => 5 cells per 100 um Xenopus somite). Energy E = sum_c [K_A/2 (A_c - A_0)^2 + Gamma/2 P_c^2] + sum_e Lambda_e l_e (Farhadifar et al. 2007 case I, Lambda_bar = 0.12, Gamma_bar = 0.04). Edges separating a posterior (-1) half-somite cell on the anterior side from an anterior (+1) half-somite cell on the posterior side (Saga & Takeda 2001 A/P compartment polarity) receive extra tension dLambda. Gradient descent, outer boundary pinned, no T1 transitions, no apical constriction / rosette formation, no 3D epithelialisation.
